Hero Otaku.name: Hero Otaku
Hero Otaku.description:
📓 You filled notebooks with pro heroes' Quirks and memorized the rankings.

📺 You have every hero interview on replay.
🔍 You can size up a Quirk from a few seconds of footage.

📈 Grants: Hero Industry +5, Quirk Analysis +5
Hero Otaku.traitNarrativeEffects: The character studied pro heroes obsessively through high school: Quirks, fighting styles, agencies and rankings, written up in notebooks. They recognize heroes on sight and analyze any Quirk they see in action.
